name: ad-allrounder-kit
description: All-round ad-delivery toolkit for beginners, spoken entirely in plain Chinese (no jargon). One assistant, five things a non-expert may want, NO expert/novice routing — everyone gets the same everyday-words treatment. (1) BUILD ADS — take a strategy (dialog or Jinshouzhi strategy sheet), review the account, produce a build-out plan, set up a PAUSED daily patrol+tuning automation. (2) TUNE RUNNING ADS — read per-ad data, grade each ad via 6 optimizer personas, give a per-ad adjustment list. (3) DIAGNOSE — running ads have a problem (money not spending / too expensive / no orders / rejected), locate the broken funnel step from the 18-problem handbook, give a [接下来这样做] list. (4) REVIEW — a finished campaign wrap-up, OR a single DAILY self-review that produces a daily report, accumulates a project playbook, and (only when a debounce rule fires) proposes strategy/monitoring iterations as before→after automation diffs confirmed by the user. (5) DOWNLOADABLE REPORT — a full printable HTML analysis doc on request. Plain-language, always ends with a numbered action list, never touches the account/automation without explicit per-item confirmation.
